response.original_title: Sea Cloud Cruises Charge Dispute: How to Request a Resolution
response.overview: You can resolve a dispute or escalate an issue with Sea Cloud Cruises by calling their US and Canada hotline at +1 866 254 7549 or their corporate office in london at +44 (0)12-04 20 81-51. Dispute and Escalation Process Onboard Resolution: Speak immediately with Guest Relations,+1 866 254 7549 your butler, or the Hotel Director to log your concern while on the ship. Corporate Contact (Off-Ship):US/Canada Hotline: +1 866 254 7549 Email: cruise-consultant@seacloud.com or info@seacloud.com Legal and Guarantor Escalation (USA Non-Performance Claims): If a claim regarding non-performance of transportation cannot be resolved directly, you can contact their legal agent/guarantor representative: Freehill Hogan & Mahar LLP (80 Pine Street, 25th Floor, New York, NY +1 866 254 7549 USA) — Phone: +1 866 254 7549, Email: reception@freehill.com.
